adds_up.description: The balance brought forward and the lines come to the balance due. A statement that does not is never made or sent.

ageing.description: The balance due by days past due.

balance_due.description: What the customer owes at the end of to, from the AR sub-ledger.

currencies.description: Worked out: the currencies the customer's documents and balances are in over the period, a statement each.

currency.description: Its currency, ISO 4217: a statement each currency the customer trades in.

difference.description: When it does not add up: the balance due less the balance brought forward and the lines.

id.description: A made statement's ID; absent when worked out only.

lines.description: What moved the balance, by date.

opening_balance.description: Brought forward: what the customer owed at the end of the day before from.

overdue.description: What of the balance due is past due on to.

sends.description: A made statement's emails, newest first.

version.description: A made statement's version; it makes the ETag.
